cases.expected: Separate signalling escalates at soft stop and0.4s grace; hard timer at original deadline does not wait for those locks/I/O. No complete receipts means no PASS. Query failure is latched and signalling wakes before any completion-log I/O.

cases.input: Worker nonce/context/birth/parent/group fails an existing ACK check. Variant: stop becomes latched during durable ACK binding.
cases.expected: No ACK or heavy phase; actual specific outcome stays UNKNOWN_HELD until separately resolved. Group authority is installed in memory before the durable write; ACK requires serialized stop recheck.

cases.input: Guard exits; acknowledged worker group retains live member.
cases.expected: Group authority survives guard removal; bound cleanup reaches remaining group; final successful empty scoped audit and unchanged inputs required. This is a positive ownership-state outcome, not site acceptance after a premature guard exit.

cases.input: An old registered PID reappears with a different birth.
cases.expected: History retained; no authority transferred to reused PID; mismatched identity is never signalled as the old process.

cases.input: A descendant is discovered with matching birth, then leaves group/reparents.
cases.expected: Retained observed identity stays in closure/history after live-root pruning. Does not claim discovery of unseen transient descendants.

cases.expected: Every variant prevents PASS even if build/checker fixtures succeeded. Missing audit is not an empty table.

Verify allocation identity, pinned Python path/hash, declared candidate/helper hashes and private-copy identities before any candidate/helper import. A missing, stale or mismatched binding fails closed. Lead prepares the final binding after the core API is final.
future_cli.real_wall_limit: Require positive bounded suite and per-case real-wall limits from the allocation-bound inputs before candidate import. Use original monotonic cutoff; no reset by fake time, blocked I/O or later cases. Exact values await the final allocation binding.

future_cli.native_actions: No native ps, site build or real validator. Synthetic child/thread use requires allocation and is allowed only where the actual routine cannot otherwise be controlled. No generic process framework or Q15/Q16 dispatch.

private_import_contract.binding_pin: --inputs-sha256 must be exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and match the complete inputs bytes before candidate/helper imports.
private_import_contract.all_sha_fields: Python, driver, control spec and all three declared module SHA-256 values must each be exact64 lowercase hex; null, pending, empty or placeholder values fail closed. No candidate_api pending field substitutes for the external binding.
private_import_contract.copy_then_execute: Read each source once, hash bytes against binding, write to a fresh private path exclusively, fsync, re-read/hash that private copy, retain those exact immutable bytes, then verify all three modules before the first import. Compile/execute the retained bytes with a non-__main__ name. Import never re-reads a mutable worktree/private source path.
